database.overview.noArea: The database overview is only available inside an area.

database.overview.name: Name
database.overview.noTables: This database holds no table yet.
database.overview.noQueries: This area holds no query file. A query file is a document with the mark db-query in its frontmatter and exactly one query block.
database.hint.queryOhneFence: The query file contains no query block; exactly one is expected. The file stays an ordinary document.
database.hint.queryMehrereFences: The query file contains {name} query blocks; exactly one is expected. The file stays an ordinary document, and every block is evaluated.

database.hint.listForm: form names no form file; expected is the name of a form file without extension. A click on a row opens the default form of the table.
database.hint.listAllow: allow is neither an operation nor a list of operations; create, update or delete is expected. Only update applies.

database.hint.listFormDateiUnbekannt: form names the form file «{name}», which does not exist in this database. A click on a row opens the default form of the table.
database.hint.listFormDateiFremd: form names the form file «{name}», which belongs to the table «{expected}» and not to the table of the query. A click on a row opens the default form of the table.
database.hint.listDateiUnbekannt: Line {zeile}: the query file «{name}» does not exist in this database; the line items area stays empty.
database.hint.listNichtBearbeitbar: Line {zeile}: the query file «{name}» does not carry editable: true; the line items area stays read-only.

database.hint.listBeziehungMehrdeutig: Line {zeile}: the line items from «{name}» have several reference fields to this table, and BY names none of them; the line items area stays empty.
database.hint.listAbfrageUngueltig: Line {zeile}: the query of the file «{name}» names no single table or cannot be extended by the relation; the line items area stays empty.
database.list.readonly.keineDatensaetze: This list form shows no records and therefore stays read-only; only a query with RECORDS is editable.
database.list.readonly.gruppiert: This list form is grouped and therefore stays read-only; a group is not a single record.
database.list.readonly.darstellungsform: This list form chooses a presentation form with DISPLAY and therefore stays read-only.
database.list.rowNotEditable: This record cannot be changed under the condition of its table.
database.list.rolleKeinUpdate: The role «{rolle}» may not change records of the table «{tabelle}».
database.list.pending: Marked; will be saved with the form.
database.list.pendingDelete: Marked for deletion; will be saved with the form.

database.hint.duplicateDatabase: A second fact sheet lies in {name}; the database is described by the first one.
database.hint.recordStrayContent: Record {position}: text outside any cell; it stays in the file and does not appear in the table.
database.hint.recordStrayContent.ohneOrt: Text outside any record; it stays in the file and does not appear in the table.
database.hint.recordCellsMissing: Record {position}: fewer cells than fields; {expected} are expected, the missing ones stay empty.

database.hint.recordFenceLine.ohneOrt: A line begins like a code fence (three backticks or tildes); it stays content and is escaped with a backslash on the next write.

database.hint.changeLogMaxPerRecord: maxPerRecord is not a usable limit; a whole number above zero or the word unlimited is expected. The entry is dropped and the application default applies.

database.hint.fieldEditableExpr: {ort}: the editability condition of the field is not a valid expression of the query language; it is dropped, and the field remains editable.
